description: The company's support requests to the BerthTime team, most recent activity first. Use it to check the status of a request; to open one use create_support_request. Internal staff notes are never included. Optional: status (active = open + pending, the default; open, pending, resolved, closed or all), limit (1-100, default 20). Returns: tickets[] {id, number (BT-1234), subject, topic, status, priority, last_message_at, last_message_by, message_count, preview}, counts by status.

company.description: Which company to act for: its id, @handle or exact name (see list_companies). Omit for the connection's default company.

name: list_support_requests
title: Support requests
